assessment.nobel_worthiness: Inflation and the quantum origin of structure reshaped cosmology and provide a compelling account of the observable universe's large-scale initial conditions.
assessment.attribution: Guth initiated inflation, Linde made decisive conceptual developments, and Mukhanov established the quantum perturbation framework central to comparison with observations.
assessment.maturity: Its consequences are extensively supported by CMB and large-scale-structure observations, and the conceptual achievement has matured over decades.
uncertainties: The detailed inflationary mechanism remains unsettled and a direct primordial-gravitational-wave signature is absent.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: WMAP converted precision CMB anisotropy mapping into a quantitative determination of the cosmological model and its parameters.
assessment.attribution: Bennett and Page were central to the experimental mission, while Spergel was a leading figure in extracting its cosmological implications.
assessment.maturity: The results have been repeatedly tested, refined, and remain foundational to observational cosmology.
uncertainties: The achievement was inherently a large collaboration, making a three-person attribution necessarily selective.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: IceCube's discovery of high-energy astrophysical neutrinos opened a genuinely new observational channel on the violent universe.
assessment.attribution: Halzen was a principal intellectual and institutional force behind IceCube and its neutrino-astronomy programme.
assessment.maturity: The astrophysical flux and neutrino astronomy programme are securely established after sustained operation.
uncertainties: The discovery depended on a very large collaboration, and credit concentrated in one name requires careful scrutiny.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: These quantum phase effects revealed that global geometry and electromagnetic potentials have directly observable physical content, with consequences across modern physics.
assessment.attribution: Aharonov is directly associated with the Aharonov-Bohm effect and Berry with the later geometric-phase formulation.
assessment.maturity: Both effects have been experimentally confirmed and have become standard conceptual and practical tools.
uncertainties: The ballot combines two historically distinct effects, so the unity of the prize formulation needs careful justification.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Afterglow localization established gamma-ray bursts as distant cosmological explosions and transformed their study from mystery to precision astrophysics.
assessment.attribution: Costa and Frontera were crucial to the observational breakthrough, with Kulkarni central to early follow-up and interpretation.
assessment.maturity: The cosmological nature of long gamma-ray bursts and their afterglows has been firmly established for decades.
uncertainties: The relative roles of satellite teams and ground-based follow-up contributors require close historical assessment.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Optical lattice clocks achieved an extraordinary advance in measurement, enabling tests of fundamental physics and a new standard for timekeeping.
assessment.attribution: Katori introduced the magic-wavelength lattice-clock concept, while Ye made decisive experimental advances and demonstrations.
assessment.maturity: The technology is reproducible internationally and its precision and scientific uses are well established.
uncertainties: The ultimate redefinition of the second and the full scope of fundamental applications are still developing.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Optical coherence tomography turned low-coherence interferometry into a transformative non-invasive imaging technique with major scientific and clinical impact.
assessment.attribution: Huang, Swanson, and Fujimoto were central to the founding demonstration and development of OCT.
assessment.maturity: Its operating principles and broad deployment in medicine are exceptionally well established.
uncertainties: Its strong biomedical character calls for attention to whether the primary recognition belongs in physics.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Gauge/gravity duality is one of the deepest conceptual advances in quantum gravity and has influenced quantum field theory, black holes, and many-body physics.
assessment.attribution: Maldacena formulated the correspondence; Witten supplied decisive extensions and its foundational dictionary.
assessment.maturity: Its internal theoretical power and broad applications have accumulated over nearly three decades.
uncertainties: There is no direct empirical confirmation of the correspondence in a physical theory of our universe.
The appropriate attribution beyond the proposed names remains historically and technically complex.
